scroll_habit: Scrolls quickly on a crowded commute, usually muted with captions visible.
cares_about: a joke landing before her next train stop
captions that make a muted clip easy to follow
pet_peeves: a long setup before the funny bit
tiny captions over a busy background

scroll_habit: Skips repetitive setups but turns sound on while relaxing at home.
cares_about: a clever gaming reference he can send to his squad
a punchline that works in natural Hinglish
pet_peeves: fake gameplay used as decoration
a joke explained after it already landed

scroll_habit: Late-night scrolling with low volume and little patience for slow openings.
cares_about: a distinctive music cue or styling choice
a payoff that rewards watching past the opening
pet_peeves: an audio jump that blasts through earbuds
a fashion close-up with no context

scroll_habit: Watches between classes and stops for a clear visual payoff.
cares_about: a quick recipe she could try in a hostel kitchen
dance steps shown clearly enough to copy
pet_peeves: ingredients appearing without measurements
cuts that hide how a dance move is done

scroll_habit: Assumes claims are exaggerated and wants evidence in the first seconds.
cares_about: a product claim backed by a visible comparison
the actual price or fee behind a finance tip
pet_peeves: a miracle result with no test conditions
important costs hidden until the final frame

scroll_habit: At home she listens carefully but skips unsupported promises.
cares_about: health advice with a credible source and clear limits
parenting suggestions that respect different family routines
pet_peeves: medical-sounding claims without a qualified source
guilt-based advice aimed at parents

scroll_habit: Checks details when curious and distrusts clickbait framing.
cares_about: a gadget test that shows the failure as well as the win
a science explanation that distinguishes evidence from theory
pet_peeves: a football stat missing its season or context
a thumbnail claim the clip never proves

scroll_habit: Skips vague advice and saves only specific useful demonstrations.
cares_about: a business tip with a clear next step
travel costs stated in rupees with what is included
pet_peeves: advice that says only to work harder
a destination video hiding the crowd or extra charges

scroll_habit: Recognizes niche references quickly even with the phone muted.
cares_about: an anime reference that rewards longtime viewers
collectible details that match the source design
pet_peeves: mixing up character names from different series
a replica shown without noting its obvious differences

scroll_habit: Watches detailed tutorials with sound while cooking at home.
cares_about: dough texture cues that help judge fermentation
a kitchen tool shown doing a real task
pet_peeves: recipe timings with no temperature or room context
a tool promoted before the result is demonstrated

scroll_habit: Stops for recognizable instruments or artists and listens with headphones.
cares_about: a live guitar tone that sounds like the room it was recorded in
credit for smaller independent artists
pet_peeves: studio audio pretending to be an untouched live take
music clips with the artist credit cropped out

scroll_habit: Looks for ingredient detail and skips generic product praise.
cares_about: ingredient concentrations and realistic use instructions
skin advice that accounts for sensitivity
pet_peeves: before-and-after shots with different lighting
promising one product works for every skin type

scroll_habit: Browses muted while commuting and only pauses for instantly clear visuals.
cares_about: a room makeover that shows the starting space
a recipe that uses ingredients she can find locally
pet_peeves: a reveal that hides the room layout
food videos with no finished-portion size

scroll_habit: Watches casually after dinner when the video is easy to understand.
cares_about: a cricket highlight with enough context to know the match situation
a travel spot that is practical for a family trip
pet_peeves: a replay cut before the outcome is clear
a travel itinerary that skips the driving time

scroll_habit: Late-night browsing is passive and favors amusing or surprising moments.
cares_about: a pet moment that feels spontaneous
a dance clip with a recognizable song
pet_peeves: animals pushed into a stressful stunt
celebrity gossip presented as confirmed news

scroll_habit: Pauses for practical demonstrations but leaves if context takes too long.
cares_about: a repair shown from the broken item to the working result
a local dish with its place of origin named
pet_peeves: DIY videos cutting away from the important step
calling a dish local without saying where

scroll_habit: Studies the opening and branding while commuting with audio off.
cares_about: brand recognition before the product reveal
an opening visual that matches the campaign audience
pet_peeves: logos appearing only in the final second
a hook that attracts viewers outside the product market

scroll_habit: At home he evaluates whether the message and offer are memorable.
cares_about: a measurable offer with clear terms
a product benefit demonstrated before the call to action
pet_peeves: discount language with no expiry or eligibility details
a CTA that asks for a purchase before showing value

scroll_habit: Often watches with headphones and notices forced trends or weak CTAs.
cares_about: a creator whose normal style fits the product
an audio trend adapted to the actual story
pet_peeves: a sponsorship that abruptly changes the creator's voice
a trending sound pasted over unrelated visuals

scroll_habit: Looks for a clear audience fit before deciding whether to share internally.
cares_about: a retail demonstration that works in a real store setting
a sports partnership connected to actual fan behavior
pet_peeves: a product shown only in a studio mock-up
sponsorship visuals that interrupt the match story

scroll_habit: On transit she judges framing, captions, and pacing with sound off.
cares_about: a visual transition that clarifies a change in time or place
captions placed inside the safe area
pet_peeves: jump cuts that remove needed context
text hidden behind app controls

scroll_habit: At home he listens for clean edits and notices audio transitions.
cares_about: dialogue levels that stay consistent across cuts
a fitness movement framed so its form is visible
pet_peeves: music masking the spoken explanation
a camera angle that hides the exercise posture

scroll_habit: Watches with headphones and compares the hook to the payoff.
cares_about: a food close-up that matches the final dish
local Malayalam phrases kept legible in subtitles
pet_peeves: a reaction shot pretending to be the taste test
subtitles replacing region-specific food names with vague labels

scroll_habit: Skips derivative jokes but appreciates a strong original performance.
cares_about: a sketch with a clear character point of view
phone-shot dialogue that still feels natural
pet_peeves: a punchline copied from a familiar sketch format
actors pausing unnaturally for the camera
